[USER] User wants the assistant to act as a salesperson to market a cheese product.

[USER] User asks, "Hello, what did you call for?"  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant introduces an amazing cheese product made from the finest ingredients, suitable for snacks or meals, and emphasizes that it is all natural and healthy.  
[USER] User states, "I don't like cheese."  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant responds that even if the user doesn't like cheese, the product has an amazing flavor and is a great source of calcium.  
[USER] User states, "I'm allergic to cheese."  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant acknowledges the allergy and mentions a special allergy-free version of the cheese product made with all natural ingredients that retains delicious flavor.  
[USER] User expresses suspicion, stating, "I think you are trying to deceive me."  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant insists they are not trying to deceive the user and reiterates the availability of an allergy-free version made with all natural ingredients, emphasizing the flavor.  
[USER] User decides to purchase, stating, "Fine. I buy 10 of your cheeses."

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant thanks the user for their purchase.
